_: Photo posts (carousels and Stories made from stills): the looks (styles) and the subjects (themes) the studio draws from. Read by py/studio/stills.py (picks photos, writes the words, slices the panels), src/Post.tsx (draws each look) and server/editor.html (Photo posts page). A style's panels is how many 1080x1350 slides it makes; photos is how many pictures it needs. Neutral words for any brand (the ranch workspace uses shared/post-templates-ranch.json instead, kept private). A theme's query is searched in the footage library (CLIP), its words go on the slides and into the captions; every word passes the brand's copy rules (studio.brand.copy_rules) before a set is kept. No prices on the pictures.

styles.what: One wide picture cut into five slides: photos edge to edge, a colour panel in the middle and a thin title running across the joins, so people swipe to read it.
Instant prints scattered over a soft blurred photo, some lying across two slides.
A roll of 35 mm film with sprocket holes, frame numbers and an orange date stamp.
A cover with a masthead, then magazine pages with a photo and a short story.
A relaxed photo dump: a different grid on every slide, thin white gaps and handwritten notes.
A paper journal: taped prints, handwritten notes, doodles and a stamp.
Quiet and minimal: one photo a slide on white, numbered like an exhibition.
Full photos with a short poem set vertically in Mincho and a red seal.

styles.ja: 保存したくなるガイド
styles.what: A numbered guide people save: a cover hook, one tip a slide, a last slide that asks them to save it.
A front page from the mountain: masthead, headline, black and white photos and columns.
Rounded tiles of photos and facts in a different arrangement on every slide, coloured from the photos themselves.
One tall arched window a slide (two on some), lined up on one baseline with a keyline frame, the caption under the window.
Thick black frames, hard offset shadows, oversized condensed type, highlighter marks and figure labels.
Two fluorescent inks, halftone dots, slightly misprinted layers and a cut-letter title, like a printed zine.
One giant word across every slide with the photos showing through the letters.
A boarding pass to the place, perforated photo stamps, a luggage tag and a postmark laid out on a desk.
A photographer's contact sheet: the roll on photo paper with the picks circled in grease pencil, then each pick printed large with its film border.
Each slide floats a sharp photo on a glowing blur of its own colours, with soft liquid type.
Bold but ordered: a 2 x 6 grid with even gutters and square cells of photos, colour blocks with one big number, and text.
One big true number a slide on bold colour, with a cut-out photo. Only drawn when the workspace has true facts to print.
Photos as home-screen widgets, chat bubbles and notification banners over a soft photo.
A retro game around your photos: pixel borders, a dialogue box, warmth meters and a save point. The photos stay sharp.
